The workflow validates. Here is the final YAML:

workflow_id: wf_ae_003
steps:
  - id: parallel_lookups
    op: parallel_execute
    params:
      branches:
        - id: lookup_author
          op: fetch_api
          params:
            endpoint: "/jsonapi/node/author"
            method: GET
            query_params:
              filter[field_author_name]: "{{ article.author_name }}"
          output: author_result
        - id: lookup_category
          op: fetch_api
          params:
            endpoint: "/jsonapi/taxonomy_term/category"
            method: GET
            query_params:
              filter[name]: "{{ article.category_name }}"
          output: category_result
        - id: lookup_issue
          op: fetch_api
          params:
            endpoint: "/jsonapi/node/magazine_issue"
            method: GET
            query_params:
              filter[field_issue_number]: "{{ article.issue_number }}"
          output: issue_result
    output: parallel_results

  - id: extract_author_id
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: "{{ author_result }}"
      field: "data[0].id"
    output: author_entity_id

  - id: handle_author_not_found
    op: handle_error
    params:
      step_ref: extract_author_id
      on_error:
        - id: flag_manual_assignment
          op: notify_user
          params:
            recipient: "cms_editorial_team"
            subject: "Author not found – manual assignment required"
            message: "Author '{{ article.author_name }}' was not found in the CMS. Article '{{ article.title }}' has been flagged for manual author assignment."
        - id: terminate_on_author_missing
          op: terminate_workflow
          params:
            reason: "Author not found; article flagged for manual assignment."

  - id: extract_category_uuid
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: "{{ category_result }}"
      field: "data[0].id"
    output: category_term_uuid

  - id: extract_issue_uuid
    op: extract_field
    params:
      source: "{{ issue_result }}"
      field: "data[0].id"
    output: issue_uuid

  - id: validate_lookups
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      inputs:
        author_entity_id: "{{ author_entity_id }}"
        category_term_uuid: "{{ category_term_uuid }}"
        issue_uuid: "{{ issue_uuid }}"
      rules:
        - field: author_entity_id
          condition: not_empty
        - field: category_term_uuid
          condition: not_empty
        - field: issue_uuid
          condition: not_empty
    output: validation_result

  - id: merge_metadata
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      sources:
        - key: author_entity_id
          value: "{{ author_entity_id }}"
        - key: category_term_uuid
          value: "{{ category_term_uuid }}"
        - key: issue_uuid
          value: "{{ issue_uuid }}"
      strategy: combine
    output: article_metadata

  - id: log_metadata_resolution
    op: log_audit
    params:
      action: "metadata_resolved"
      details: "Author: {{ author_entity_id }}, Category: {{ category_term_uuid }}, Issue: {{ issue_uuid }}"
    output: audit_log_entry
